outcome: admission to Special Care Nursery or Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
cohort: Nulliparous women with a singleton post-term pregnancy (145 South Asian-born and 272 Australian- and New Zealand-born)
finding: Post-term South Asian-born women experienced higher rates of fetal compromise and cesarean sections compared to Australian- and New Zealand-born women, while abnormal CTG or AFI were not predictive of adverse outcomes in either group.
mod_finding: The study found that post-term South Asian women were significantly more likely to have an intrapartum cesarean section compared to Australian- and New Zealand-born women.
